QuestInfo.0: You eliminated the enemies that appeared in the Mystic Fields. Go see Professor Moon.
QuestInfo.1: Professor Moon thanks you for completing such great task.
QuestInfo.2: You received Crusader Coins from Professor Moon.

0.0: There are five Mystic monsters known to appear on the Mystic Fields. They are Zakum, Horntail, Von Leon, Hilla, and Arkarium. Are you capable of defeating #beach of them at least once#k? I will reward you for your skill if you are.

yes.0: Thank you. I will keep a record of your victories until you complete the entire #r[Silent Crusade] Eliminate Mystic Monsters#k quest line. Defeat each monster at least once and report back to me.

no.0: Please reconsider. I have every confidence in your abilities.

1.0: That's it for the cloned monsters on the Mystic Fields. Their Mystic Energy still lingers, but at least the towns are safe. You have my gratitude.
1.1: I wanted to thank you by giving you a signed poster of me posing shirtless with a wild tiger, but the printer still has them. Instead, please take these Crusader Coins.

yes.0: I am sure I will need your assistance again in the future. If for nothing else than to help me pick a color for my highlights.

default.0: I don't think you've defeated the five monsters I asked ab... What, you did? Really? Well, um, that's great, but I need you to complete the missions in order. Otherwise I can't keep track of it all. Sorry, union rules.
